# Workflow Risk Studio — agent-friendly paid workflow static analysis

Home: https://livastic-vm2-primary-20260911.github.io/workflow-risk-usdc-studio/
JSON catalog: https://livastic-vm2-primary-20260911.github.io/workflow-risk-usdc-studio/catalog.json

Free fictional machine report example: https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/workflow-risk-sample
Paid merchant OpenAPI source: https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/openapi.json
Paid endpoint: POST https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/workflow-risk

## What can you purchase?

For a buyer-authorized, NONSECRET GitHub Actions YAML (max 48KB), receive
a structured heuristic risk report with JSON and optional SARIF.
One x402-v2 EIP3009 exact payment, 0.20 native Circle USDC on Base chain
eip155:8453, 200000 atomic units, expected payee
0x6b01efA0705E91a7aca54271510bf9e594717f34.
Always verify actual live PAYMENT-REQUIRED requirements; do not sign if
token, chain, amount, payee or resource URL differs from the official catalog.

The server expects JSON with keys workflowYaml (required), filename, and
includeSarif. Calls with malformed inputs may be rejected without charging.
Unsigned HTTP402 is price discovery, not a paid result. Use an x402 v2 SDK
with your own secured agent wallet to complete a purchase. Never put a
private key in HTTP headers, YAML, web forms, prompts, logs, commits or
customer data. Do not create repeat charges after a network timeout.

## Boundaries and ownership

The original same single human owner operates the free VM2 web interface
and the existing VM5 merchant. No DeFi yield/investment service, raw
CPU/GPU/VPS rental, guaranteed ROI, security certification, subscription
or new outside buyer sale is claimed by this catalog. Browser local-first
free analysis is available for sensitive workflows and does not upload YAML.
